statements.text: When Apple trades at its all-time high in the middle of a breakout on rising volume, the price rose in 83 % of 12 independent cases within 3 trading days.
When Apple trades at its all-time high on steady volume, the price rose in 75 % of 16 independent cases within 3 trading days.
After a fall of 20 % from its all-time high, Apple came back every time: in all 5 cases since 2016 the old high was reached again within 13 months at most.
After a fall of 30 % from its all-time high, Apple came back every time: in all 4 cases since 2016 the old high was reached again within 10 months at most.
